text:
Predicates:
Private(x) ::: x is a private university.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League university.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
MovedTo(x, y) ::: x moved to y.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Name(x, y) ::: x's name is y.

Premises:
YaleUniversity ∧ Private(YaleUniversity) ∧ IvyLeague(YaleUniversity) ∧ ResearchUniversity(YaleUniversity) ∧ MovedTo(YaleUniversity, NewHaven) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university that moved to New Haven.

Conclusion:
MovedTo(YaleUniversity, NewHaven) ::: A private Ivy League research university moved to New Haven.
